title: Costs disclosure cover letter
description: Covers the costs disclosure sent to the client.
guidance:
Write to our client, enclosing our costs disclosure for the matter.

- Say that the costs disclosure is enclosed and that it sets out how our costs are worked out and our estimate of them.
- Give the fixed fee, cap or estimate in one sentence, as the matter's fee facts give it; use a placeholder if they give none.
- Say that the client may ask us about the costs at any time, and how to contact the responsible lawyer.
- Ask the client to read it and, if the instructions say so, to sign and return the agreement.
- Don't restate the disclosure itself, and don't add terms that aren't in the matter's fee facts or the instructions.
